facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan costs $0 and includes 75 credits.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, a ~30-second video on Wavemaker runs about 75 credits.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, a Wavemaker refine (chat edit) costs about 15 credits.

Wavemaker's Pro plan rolls over 20% of unused monthly credits.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's credit packs never expire, according to the vendor.
Wavemaker's AI storyboard includes 21 presets.
Wavemaker's REST API at /api/v1/videos is available on Pro plans and up.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's REST API has a limit of 30 requests per minute.
